6814.title: Late terminal text insertion is not forwarded
6814.rootCauseOneLine: The pinned xterm bundle checks the textarea before late insertion, then rejects the composed input because keydown is still recorded.

prReviews.topFinding: The timer and already-sent gates align with the reproduced event-order loss; the PR branch was not executed.

6814.proposedFix: Recover only unsent late non-composition text after the process-key check; preserve exactly-once delivery. Existing open PR 6815 already links the issue, so no duplicate fix was opened.
6814.caveats: Repeated synthetic DOM reproduction in two clean trusted checkouts, not native Safari or a physical iPhone. Full build failed in pre-existing GitHub plugin SDK output resolution.
